trap.label: research incontável
trap.why: Pesquisa em português tem plural. Em inglês research é incontável.

mcq.q: Complete: The study **___** that it works.

fix.wrong: The team told that it works.
fix.right: The team said that it works.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “Scientists tested the drug.”
Reescreva com said: “‘It works,’ the team said.”
rewrite.answer: The team said that it worked.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “The result is likely to change.”
rewrite.answer: The result is likely to change.
